title: QuickTPA
description: A simple and polished TPA plugin that lets players send and accept teleport requests with clean GUI prompts, sounds, and safe request handling.
body:
This plugin adds a simple, reliable, and user-friendly TPA (teleport request) system to your Minecraft server. Players can send teleport requests to others and safely teleport once the request is accepted, helping improve multiplayer navigation without giving unrestricted teleport access.

The system includes clear request notifications, accept/deny options, cooldown protection, and polished feedback with sounds and actionbar messages for a smooth player experience. It is lightweight, easy to use, and designed to work well on modern Paper/Spigot servers without unnecessary complexity.

Perfect for survival, SMP, and community servers that want a clean and safe teleport request feature.
